title: What Breaks and What Comes Back: Capability Damage and Recovery in Depth-Pruned Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.00877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Depth pruning removes whole Transformer blocks to make a language model smaller and faster, but the damage is not spread evenly across what the model can do, and a short fine-tuning run, called healing, decides what comes back. We measure this for small models used as agents. Four instruction-tuned models of 1.2-1.7B parameters (Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and OLMo-2-1B) are pruned and healed, and six capabilities are tracked: structured output, function calling, instruction following, mathematical reasoning, safety refusal and knowledge. Three results hold across the families. First, function calling and math collapse in every model (retention 0.00-0.07 of the unpruned score), and the order in which capabilities break agrees closely across the four (Kendall's W = 0.92; 0.62 after correcting for chance floors). translated_title: 什么被破坏，什么能恢复：深度剪枝小型语言模型中的能力损伤与恢复
translated_abstract: 深度剪枝通过移除整个 Transformer 块来使语言模型更小、更快，但这种损伤在模型各项能力上的分布并不均匀，而一次短暂的微调（称为“愈合”healing）决定了哪些能力能够恢复。我们针对用作智能体的小模型对这一现象进行了测量。四个经过指令微调的、参数量为 1.2–1.7B 的模型（Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B 和 OLMo-2-1B）经过剪枝和愈合，并追踪六项能力：结构化输出、函数调用、指令遵循、数学推理、安全拒答和知识。三个结果在各模型家族中均成立。第一，函数调用和数学能力在所有模型中都崩溃（保留率仅为未剪枝得分的 0.00–0.07），且能力崩溃的顺序在四个模型之间高度一致（Kendall's W = 0.92；经随机底线校正后为 0.62）。第二，训练哪些参数与训练哪些数据同样重要：完全微调最后三个块而不是……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该研究系统测量了深度剪枝后小型语言模型六项能力的损伤与恢复，发现函数调用和数学能力在所有模型家族中都会崩溃且崩溃顺序高度一致，而“愈合”微调时选择训练哪些参数与选择训练数据同等重要。
en_tdlr: Depth pruning damages small language model capabilities unevenly but consistently—function calling and math collapse first across all model families—and during "healing" fine-tuning, which parameters are trained matters as much as which data is used.
